$comment: Hand-edit THIS file only. IA.md and matrix.csv are generated by build.mjs. Templates carry an extra `group` field (T1 product, company A/B, cms, …) and optional `notes` — both ignored by the scripts.

meta.source: https://www.lightdash.com/ — specs/sitemap.txt (121 URLs) + CLONE_SPEC.md + specs/*.md + specs/cms/*.json
meta.status: measured-from-specs + reconciled against the built clone and src/ JSX (2026-10-13, update pass)
meta.scope: All 121 sitemap URLs except 3 unpublished ones: /xdrafts/lightdash-vs-looker, /xdrafts/lightdash-vs-looker-v2, /old-home. Unknown URLs render the /404 template (catch-all) and are not counted as routes.

chromeAxis.dark-home: dark navbar + dark mobile nav + Talk modal over the full-viewport iframe; no banner, no CTA band, no footer
chromeAxis.light-banner-cta: announcement bar + light navbar + content + snake CTA band + footer
chromeAxis.light-cta: light navbar (no banner) + content + snake CTA band (normal or narrow) + footer
chromeAxis.light-no-cta: light navbar (no banner) + content + footer, no snake CTA band

meta.generatedBy: Hand-authored by an agent following the ia-builder skill.

categories.CHROME: Site chrome repeated across routes: navbars, mobile nav, announcement bar, footer, Talk-to-team modal.
categories.HERO: Page-opening block: title, subtitle, primary buttons and the hero visual.
categories.APP: States inside the homepage Game Boy iframe app. These are views, not routes.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: logo rows/grids, quotes, testimonials, stats, compliance seals, speakers.
categories.FEATURES: Product/benefit explanation modules: tabs, card grids, comparisons, split rows.
categories.CONTENT: Substantive body content: FAQ, rich text, CMS headers/sidebars, legal text, page-specific editorial blocks.
categories.CONVERSION: Pricing, plan comparison, booking and application forms.
categories.LISTING: Collection listings and filters: blog/story grids, directories, related-content rails.
categories.CTA: Call-to-action bands placed at the end of a page or main column.

app.view-product.description: Game Boy app view "Product": 5-slide carousel (BI as code, Data Apps, Conversational Analytics, Metrics Catalog, Embedded) with LEARN MORE links. App state, not a route. CLONE_SPEC §6.4.
